newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady with moderate enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady with moderate enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes hovered around recent levels on Thursday with moderate enquiries, traders said.
Levels were supported after news that Indonesian authorities boarded several tankers refuelling outside Singapore port limits, saying the ships were in Indonesia's territorial waters.
"Trading interest increases after the news but we still have to see how the cargo market moves later," said one trader.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $99/$101 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was at around $103.
